scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @restaurant/server" "npm run dev -w @restaurant/client"
scripts.dev:server: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @restaurant/server
scripts.dev:client: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @restaurant/client
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @restaurant/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w @restaurant/shared && npm run typecheck -w @restaurant/server && npm run typecheck -w @restaurant/client
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @restaurant/shared && npm run lint -w @restaurant/server && npm run lint -w @restaurant/client
